summary: PrqCertifications is a component part of the HSPnet.UserControls.StaffProfile namespace dealing with certification management for staff profiles. The control involves UI elements like panels, update panels, grid views, form views, and various data source objects. It supports functionalities for adding, editing, and deleting certification records.
purpose: The purpose of PrqCertifications is to manage staff certification data within the HSPnet system, providing an interface for viewing and modifying certification details.

workflows.name: Certificate Management
steps: Adding a new certification entry via a form.
Editing an existing certification entry in the form view.
Deleting a certification entry using the grid view commands.
Displaying details in a modal popup for selected actions.
